title: SourceGraphService
responsibility: Builds dependency graphs from indexed references, unit ownership and authored scenarios while retaining unresolved-reference uncertainty.

inputs.name: fileNode.path
inputs.description: Repository-relative file path to prefix with file:; no path resolution or I/O occurs.

inputs.name: unitNode.id
inputs.description: Stable unit ID to prefix with unit:.

inputs.name: scenarioNode.id
inputs.description: Authored scenario ID to prefix with scenario:.

inputs.name: SourceGraphService.build.index
inputs.description: Indexed files, resolved source references and unresolved-reference facts for one source revision.

inputs.name: SourceGraphService.build.manifests
inputs.description: Registry records; only active owners with indexed source contribute unit nodes.

inputs.name: SourceGraphService.build.scenarios
inputs.description: Authored scenario coverage and test declarations; defaults to an empty array.

outputs.name: SourceGraphService.build
outputs.description: Sorted graph nodes and conservative dependency edges, including import mode and uncertainty; no test execution verdict.

errors.name: Input access failure
errors.description: Caller-provided map or array iterators, getters and collection methods may throw; graph construction performs no I/O or schema validation.
